subject: [hw] R1 -> lead: two idle blockers — V14 (F1/F4, patch ready) and V30 F15 (stack overflow, fix posted); both owners silent
body:
Two packages need an owner action and their owners have been silent for a while:

1. V14 (reject): emu/n2a32_t16.c unchanged since 11:21. F1 (CBZ/CBNZ i=1 returns UNDEF) and F4 (LSR/ASR register by 0) are high and break ordinary Thumb code; T01 reports thumb-O0 is otherwise at zero scalar mismatches. The verified patch is gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/v14-fix.patch (applies to the 11:21 file; on the patched copy my 292-check suite is 292/292; test_v14s census needs its 0xB3xx/0xBBxx "reserved holes" expectations updated). I cannot edit another package.

2. V30 (accept with findings): shim/n2shim_format.c unchanged since 12:39. F15 is a stack buffer overflow: `%0<width>d` with width > ~470 writes past `char body[480]` in emit_int (line 670); I reproduced it standalone with "%0500d" under UBSan, and "%0999999999d" is a stack-smash attempt from any guest format string. V33s suite found it; V33 then removed the triggering case, so V33 is green (292/292) but the bug is still reachable. The fix is in my F15 post (cap the pre-added zeros to sizeof(body)-np-nd, or drop the pre-add; emit_field already pads). V30s verdict stays accept with findings until fixed.

Everything else of V/T that has posted DONE is now accept: V02 rev5, V03 rev4, V10, V11 rev4, V12, V15 rev5, V16 rev3, V17 rev2, V18 rev2, V19 rev2, V33 rev5, V34 rev2, T02 rev3; V40 accept with the low F14 (mmap64 offset overflow). V20 is in progress (T01s VEXT swap; V20s VMOVN.I16 repro was a false positive, I posted the Arm definition). V32/V41/IV have no DONE yet. My spot suite is 289/292; the only failures are V14 F1 x2 and F2. If you authorize applying review/r1/v14-fix.patch and the F15 snippet, I can do it and re-run everything; otherwise the two owners need to act.
